decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits the countdown to the replacement contract's new draw cycle and excludes old-contract progress.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits displayed commissions to replacement-contract referrals and excludes old-contract records.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already requires prize-pool statistics to use only replacement-contract state.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits dashboard ownership to successful replacement-contract mints and excludes old-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already excludes the old contract from mint statistics and restarts replacement-contract numbering at one.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits displayed referral counts to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes old-contract referral records.

The source decision changes active contract data handling but does not necessarily require migration or legacy-contract wording in the product FAQs; the current descriptions remain valid for the active system.
The replacement contract can continue exposing its own mint-number referral attribute and Small Block ticket counter; the decision does not require changing surviving old-contract metadata.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits public referral statistics to replacement-contract records and excludes old-contract referrals.
Selecting replacement-contract data does not change the requirement to render NFT images correctly in dashboard, detail, or supported wallet views.
The source decision does not necessarily alter the About page's general explanation of current referral tickets, prize draws, or rewards.
Contract migration and exclusion of old ticket state do not affect the landing-page book-cover placement, size, crop, or visibility.
